c1.note: 10-K lists Jewel-Osco among banners of Albertsons Companies, Inc. (NYSE: ACI, Boise); all variants consistent.

c2.note: 10-K cover shows Class A common stock, ticker ACI, on NYSE.

c3.note: 10-K lists principal executive offices at 250 Parkcenter Blvd., Boise, Idaho.

c4.note: About Us page says Jewel-Osco is a vital part of Albertsons Inc., a privately held grocery company; the 'privately held' wording is outdated since ACI is public, but the page does say it.

c6.note: The page says 'our parent company—AB Acquisition LLC—acquired Jewel-Osco from SUPERVALU' in 2013, so it does name it as parent, though that is dated history.

c7.note: Page states AB Acquisition LLC acquired Jewel-Osco from SUPERVALU in 2013; historical context.

c9.note: Page says the parent doubled its store base through the 2015 Safeway merger.

c10.note: 10-K states 22 well known banners including Jewel-Osco.

c11.note: 10-K lists Jewel-Osco among banners; the auditor's report is dated April 27, 2026, consistent with that filing date.

c12.note: Press release lists 22 banners including Jewel-Osco; the July 23, 2026 date is not shown in the excerpts but the release is from 2026 (it cites June 20, 2026 store counts).

c13.note: Albertsons overview lists Jewel-Osco among its banners; the media policy page also names ACME and Balducci's.

c14.note: Banner list matches the overview page exactly.

c16.note: July 23, 2026 press release states the East Region will include the Jewel-Osco, Mid-Atlantic and Shaw's markets.

c17.note: Jewel-Osco's own page puts the 2013 acquisition from Supervalu by AB Acquisition and says Albertsons is the current parent. The 1999 American Stores deal is well known (Albertsons bought American Stores, Jewel's owner, in 1999), but the page doesn't mention it. A date gap from 1999 to 2006 is the nu

c18.note: Supervalu acquired Jewel-Osco in 2006 (from Albertsons) and sold it in 2013 (to AB Acquisition); the claim is correct on that history.

c19.note: The July 2026 release and the Feb 2026 10-K list Jewel-Osco among current Albertsons banners; no sale found.

c20.note: Jewel-Osco says it is part of Albertsons and that AB Acquisition LLC acquired it in 2013; the 10-K shows Albertsons Companies, Inc. as the parent holding company.

c21.note: The 10-K refers to the termination of the Merger Agreement, with retention payments made Dec 12, 2024. The Kroger litigation is not shown in the passages, but it is known from outside the passages.

c24.note: The 10-K says all operations run through ACI's subsidiaries. The entity names Jewel Food Stores, Inc. and American Drug Stores LLC are not in the passages but are consistent with known filings.

c15.note: The leadership page lists Tom Lofland as President, Jewel-Osco Division, so Jewel-Osco is an Albertsons Companies division. The Jewel-Osco about page and the ACI press release trademark note also tie the banner to Albertsons.

c23.note: Search results on the Q2 fiscal 2026 results (quarter ended Sept 12, 2026) say Albertsons is reviewing its 'portfolio of banners'. They name no Jewel-Osco sale. The saved ACI press release does not contain this quote, and I did not open the Q2 release itself.
